courses.title: Batch 19 Course
courses.shortDescription: Complete Google Ads, conversion tracking, AI copywriting, and search campaign masterclass series.
courses.fullDescription: Comprehensive training delivered to Batch 19 students covering end-to-end Google Ads architecture, keyword match types, GTM conversion tracking, Performance Max, Demand Gen, remarketing, and account auditing.
courses.courseIntroduction: Direct live recording series from Batch 19. All lessons are arranged in exact sequence from Class 01 to the Final Audit Class.
learningOutcomes: Master Google Ads auction mechanics, bidding strategies, and campaign structures
Conduct AI-assisted keyword research and dynamic ad copy insertion
Implement enterprise conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, and call tracking with GTM
Run Google Display, YouTube Video, and Performance Max campaigns with confidence

courses.title: Batch 20 Course
courses.shortDescription: Advanced Google Ads masterclass focusing on PPC campaigns, PMax, conversion tracking, and direct client acquisition.
courses.fullDescription: The complete video series from Batch 20. Learn modern Google Ads practices including Enhanced Conversion Tracking, GTM, Display Ads, YouTube Video Ads, and high-ticket client hunting outside traditional freelance marketplaces.
courses.courseIntroduction: Batch 20 lecture series covering everything from foundational 4Ps of marketing to client acquisition strategies.
learningOutcomes: Build agency-level Google Search and Display ad campaigns
Optimize Performance Max (PMax) with custom asset groups and audience signals
Track full-funnel conversions using Google Tag Manager
Land high-value digital marketing clients outside crowded marketplaces

courses.title: Google Ads — Legacy Version
courses.shortDescription: Archive edition of traditional Google AdWords strategies and legacy search campaign structures.
courses.fullDescription: An extensive historical archive and reference course analyzing legacy Google AdWords interfaces, manual bidding strategies, and standard keyword match mechanics prior to automated Smart Bidding updates.
learningOutcomes: Understand legacy AdWords bidding mechanics
Analyze historical campaign data and bidding models

courses.title: Google Ads — Updated Version
courses.shortDescription: Modern Google Ads platform guidelines, Smart Bidding, AI-generated assets, and Performance Max.
courses.fullDescription: The updated standard for Google Ads management. Covers automated campaign management, first-party data integration, privacy-centric measurement, and AI-driven asset generation.
learningOutcomes: Leverage AI Max asset generation for responsive ads
Master privacy-compliant measurement and first-party cookies

courses.title: Digital Marketing Basic Course
courses.shortDescription: A beginner-friendly introduction to digital advertising, branding, and online marketing channels.
courses.fullDescription: Start your journey into online marketing. This course provides a gentle introduction to social media, email campaigns, search engines, and basic performance metrics.
learningOutcomes: Understand core online marketing terminology
Create basic social media graphics and promotional copy

courses.title: Google Analytics Course
courses.shortDescription: Master Google Analytics 4 (GA4): custom event tracking, exploration reports, and attribution modelling.
courses.fullDescription: Complete guide to GA4 data collection and reporting. Learn event-based data models, custom funnel explorations, BigQuery exporting, and attribution comparison.
learningOutcomes: Configure custom events and parameters in GA4
Build funnel and path exploration reports

courses.title: Digital Marketing & Freelancing Course
courses.shortDescription: The 38-class flagship course: digital foundation, social media, advanced SEO, and freelance marketplace mastery.
courses.fullDescription: The definitive 38-class curriculum designed to take you from foundational productivity tools and social media marketing to advanced Google Ads, technical SEO, and international freelancing on Fiverr and Upwork.
courses.courseIntroduction: Structured into two extensive sections: 16 Foundation & Social Media classes followed by 22 Advanced Marketing, SEO & Marketplace classes.
learningOutcomes: Master essential design, office productivity, and personal branding tools
Launch professional Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube campaigns
Execute end-to-end SEO, keyword research, site audits, and Google Search Console indexing
Establish a thriving freelance presence on Fiverr and Upwork with verified gig strategies

courses.title: SEO Course (Copy)
courses.shortDescription: Comprehensive search engine optimization: technical audits, on-page optimization, and authority link building.
courses.fullDescription: Step-by-step search engine optimization curriculum. Learn how search engines crawl, render, and index web pages, and rank websites consistently in organic search results.
learningOutcomes: Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits
Execute white-hat backlink building campaigns
